dont.zh: 考试期间不得使用未授权工具。

scope.en: Scope separation required: Graduate School of Management (GSoM) GenAI rules and exam-retake sanctions apply to GSoM only; University ICT Regulation Art. 39 restricts sensitive inputs to externally hosted AI across the university; and the July 2026 AI teaching-support decree is listed in the official index with operative text still unverified.
scope.zh: 严格区分适用范围：管理学院（GSoM）生成式AI规则与重考处分路径仅适用于GSoM；全校《ICT条例》第39条禁止向校外托管AI输入列举敏感材料；2026年7月AI教学支持新法令仅见于官方目录，正文待核实。

coursework:draft-action-1.text: Follow course teacher AI authorization in GSoM lessons and exams.
coursework:draft-action-1.summaryZh: GSoM课程和考试遵循教师AI许可决定。
coursework:draft-action-1.scope: Polimi Graduate School of Management (GSoM) Code of Ethics and Conduct; teacher authorization governs AI use in GSoM lessons and coursework.

evidence.quote: Students must respect the teachers’ decisions about the use of Generative AI in lessons or during examinations. In general, it is up to the teachers to decide whether it is allowed or not.
evidence.location: §4, Teachers’ Authorisation; SHA-256 identifies this retained UTF-8 excerpt, not raw HTML/PDF; physical page and original offsets unavailable.

disclosure:draft-action-2.text: Document prompts and responses for authorized GSoM exam AI use.
disclosure:draft-action-2.summaryZh: GSoM获准的考试AI使用记录提示词和回答。
disclosure:draft-action-2.scope: GSoM exam disclosure requirement (documenting where and how AI was used, including prompts and replies); no general university-wide disclosure template is verified.

evidence.quote: If they are allowed to use Generative AI, they must record where and how in their work, indicating the prompts they gave and the replies received.
evidence.location: §4, Compulsory Declaration; SHA-256 identifies this retained UTF-8 excerpt, not raw HTML/PDF; physical page and original offsets unavailable.

privacy_data:draft-action-3.text: Treat commercial AI inputs as potentially visible and recorded by third parties.
privacy_data:draft-action-3.summaryZh: 将商业AI输入视为可能被第三方查看和记录。
privacy_data:draft-action-3.scope: University ICT Regulation Article 39 (effective 1 January 2025); prohibits submitting listed sensitive material to externally hosted AI and warns of third-party visibility and recording.

evidence.quote: Gli utenti devono essere informati e resi consapevoli che i dati forniti a strumenti di IA commerciali possono essere visibili e registrati da terze parti, con potenziali rischi per la sicurezza.
evidence.location: Art. 39(2), PDF physical page 25, printed p.23; SHA-256 identifies this retained UTF-8 excerpt, not raw HTML/PDF; physical page and original offsets unavailable.

privacy_data:draft-action-4.text: Do not submit listed sensitive material to AI hosted outside the University.
privacy_data:draft-action-4.summaryZh: 不得向校外托管AI提供条例列举的敏感材料。
privacy_data:draft-action-4.scope: University ICT Regulation Article 39 (effective 1 January 2025); prohibits submitting listed sensitive material to externally hosted AI and warns of third-party visibility and recording.

evidence.quote: È vietato fornire dati sensibili a sistemi di IA ospitati al di fuori dell’Ateneo, fra cui: password e nomi utente; informazioni di identificazione personale; dati non anonimizzati; dati protetti da diritto d’autore; dati relativi alla proprietà intellettuale dell'Ateneo; qualsiasi dato che potrebbe danneggiare la reputazione del Politecnico di Milano.
evidence.location: Art. 39(1), PDF physical page 25, printed p.23; SHA-256 identifies this retained UTF-8 excerpt, not raw HTML/PDF; physical page and original offsets unavailable.

academic_integrity:draft-action-5.text: Do not use unauthorized tools during examinations.
academic_integrity:draft-action-5.summaryZh: 考试期间不得使用未授权工具。
academic_integrity:draft-action-5.scope: University Student Disciplinary Regulations (hearing notice at least 10 days in advance and trusted-person assistance under Art. 5) kept separate from GSoM's contractual warning/single-retake route.

evidence.quote: During exams or other forms of assessment (including the final exam), it is strictly forbidden to cheat, use unauthorized tools, communicate with other candidates and/or other individuals
evidence.location: Art.3(1), English translation; SHA-256 identifies this retained UTF-8 excerpt, not raw HTML/PDF; physical page and original offsets unavailable.

academic_integrity:draft-procedure-1.text: Under the University Student Disciplinary Regulations (Art. 5 simplified route), the student receives notice of the hearing at least 10 days in advance and may be assisted by a trusted person.
academic_integrity:draft-procedure-1.summaryZh: 根据全校《学生纪律条例》（第5条简易程序），学校须提前至少10天向学生发出听证会通知，且学生可由一名信任人员协助出席。
academic_integrity:draft-procedure-1.scope: University Student Disciplinary Regulations (hearing notice at least 10 days in advance and trusted-person assistance under Art. 5) kept separate from GSoM's contractual warning/single-retake route.

evidence.quote: During exams or other forms of assessment (including the final exam), it is strictly forbidden to cheat, use unauthorized tools, communicate with other candidates and/or other individuals
evidence.location: Art.3(1), English translation; SHA-256 identifies this retained UTF-8 excerpt, not raw HTML/PDF; physical page and original offsets unavailable.

evidence.quote: the date of the hearing, giving at least 10 days' notice, and specifying that the student may be assisted by a trusted person;
evidence.location: Art.5(2)(c), PDF physical page 5, printed p.5; SHA-256 identifies this retained UTF-8 excerpt, not raw HTML/PDF; physical page and original offsets unavailable.

academic_integrity:draft-procedure-2.text: Within the Graduate School of Management (GSoM) only, breaching the GSoM GenAI rules triggers a Course Director warning and allows repeating the directly related exam at most once (with a second warning if unsuccessful).
academic_integrity:draft-procedure-2.summaryZh: 仅在管理学院（GSoM）范围内，违反GSoM生成式AI规则将由课程主任发出警告，且直接相关的考试最多仅允许重考一次（若重考未通过可发第二次警告）。
academic_integrity:draft-procedure-2.scope: University Student Disciplinary Regulations (hearing notice at least 10 days in advance and trusted-person assistance under Art. 5) kept separate from GSoM's contractual warning/single-retake route.

evidence.quote: The student may repeat the exam - to which the breach is directly related - once at most;
evidence.location: §5.2 sanctions; SHA-256 identifies this retained UTF-8 excerpt, not raw HTML/PDF; physical page and original offsets unavailable.

coursework.en: Teacher authorization is expressly specified for GSoM; no university-wide AI coursework permission proven.
coursework.zh: GSoM明确由教师决定AI使用许可，尚无可证实的全校作业统一许可。
coursework.meaningEn: Polimi Graduate School of Management (GSoM) Code of Ethics and Conduct; teacher authorization governs AI use in GSoM lessons and coursework.
coursework.meaningZh: 米兰理工大学管理学院（GSoM）《伦理与行为守则》；GSoM课堂与课程作业中的AI使用由任课教师授权决定。

exams.en: GSoM exam AI use depends on teacher permission; university rules separately prohibit cheating and unauthorized tools.
exams.zh: GSoM考试用AI须教师批准；全校考试纪律另禁止作弊和未授权工具。
exams.meaningEn: GSoM exam authorization rules alongside University Student Disciplinary Regulations prohibiting unauthorized tools during examinations.
exams.meaningZh: GSoM考试AI授权规则，以及全校《学生纪律条例》关于考试期间严禁使用未授权工具的规定。

disclosure.en: For allowed GSoM exam AI use, document where and how AI was used, prompts and replies.
disclosure.zh: GSoM获准考试用AI须记录位置、方式、提示词和回复。
disclosure.meaningEn: GSoM exam disclosure requirement (documenting where and how AI was used, including prompts and replies); no general university-wide disclosure template is verified.
disclosure.meaningZh: GSoM考试披露要求（获准使用AI时须记录使用位置、方式、提示词及回复）；未核得全校通用的学生作业披露模板。

privacy_data.en: ICT Article 39 prohibits specified sensitive inputs to externally hosted AI and warns about third-party visibility and recording.
privacy_data.zh: ICT第39条禁止向外部托管AI输入列举敏感资料，并警示第三方查看与记录。
privacy_data.meaningEn: University ICT Regulation Article 39 (effective 1 January 2025); prohibits submitting listed sensitive material to externally hosted AI and warns of third-party visibility and recording.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 全校《ICT条例》第39条（2025年1月1日生效）；禁止向校外托管AI提交条例列举的敏感资料，并警示商业AI输入可能被第三方查看和记录。

approved_tools.en: My Learning Talk is a course-focused institutional learning project, not general exam authorization.
approved_tools.zh: My Learning Talk是课程导向的校内学习项目，不能视为通用考试许可。
approved_tools.meaningEn: My Learning Talk (MLT) institutional course-focused learning project; participation does not grant general examination permission.
approved_tools.meaningZh: My Learning Talk（MLT）课程导向型校内学习项目；参与该项目不构成通用考试AI使用许可。

research_publication.en: General ethical and lawful AI use applies; thesis-specific disclosure, authorship and publisher rules not verified.
research_publication.zh: 通用伦理合法使用要求已确认；学位论文声明、作者资格和期刊规则未核实。
research_publication.meaningEn: University ICT Regulation general lawful/ethical AI use principles; thesis-specific authorship and disclosure clauses remain unverified.
research_publication.meaningZh: 全校《ICT条例》关于合法与合乎伦理使用AI的一般原则；学位论文署名与专门披露细则尚待核实。

academic_integrity.en: Exam cheating and unauthorized tools are prohibited; no direct AI-specific blanket offense inferred.
academic_integrity.zh: 考试作弊、未授权工具被禁止，但不能由此推断AI一概违纪。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: University Student Disciplinary Regulations (hearing notice at least 10 days in advance and trusted-person assistance under Art. 5) kept separate from GSoM's contractual warning/single-retake route.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 全校《学生纪律条例》（第5条规定的提前至少10天听证通知及信任人员协助权），与GSoM合同性质的警告/单次重考路径严格区分。

teaching_guidance.en: An effective July 2026 AI teaching-support decree exists in the official index; its operative clauses remain unverified.
teaching_guidance.zh: 官方目录列出2026年7月AI教学支持新命令，正文义务待核实。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Official regulation index listing the July 2026 AI teaching-support decree (D.D. Rep. 10315/2026); operative clauses were not retrieved in full.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 官方规章目录所列2026年7月AI教学支持法令（D.D. Rep. 10315/2026）；法令正文具体条款尚未取回核实。

security_procurement.en: ICT rules restrict externally hosted AI data inputs; staff guidelines and procurement controls remain unverified.
security_procurement.zh: ICT条例限制外部AI数据输入；工作人员指南及采购制度细则待核实。
security_procurement.meaningEn: University ICT Regulation Article 39 controls on externally hosted AI services, plus the indexed 2026 teaching-support decree.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 全校《ICT条例》第39条对校外托管AI服务的管控要求，以及目录所列2026年教学支持法令。
